description.zh: 数据库名称。支持小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度1~64。
description.en: The name of the database. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 实体ID，用来标识用户的唯一性，如用户ID、员工ID等。每个实体可包含多张人脸图片。支持大小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度为1~64。
description.en: The entity ID, which is used to identify the uniqueness of a user, such as a user ID or employee ID. Each entity can contain multiple face images. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 自定义信息。支持字母、数字、标点符号和汉字。不超过512个字符。
description.en: The custom information. The value can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters. The maximum length is 512 characters.

description.zh: 人脸图像URL地址。人脸必须是正面无遮挡单人人脸。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。URL长度不超过1024个字符。
description.en: The URL of the face image. The face must be a frontal, unoccluded, single-person face. We recommend that you use an OSS URL from the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or OSS URLs from regions other than China (Shanghai), see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). The maximum URL length is 1024 characters.

description.zh: 质量分阈值。对新增人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示新增人脸图片质量不符合要求，添加失败。取值范围\[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑。
description.en: The quality score threshold. A quality analysis is performed on the new face image. If the quality score is less than this threshold, the face image quality does not meet the requirements and the addition fails. Valid values: \[0.0,100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that the quality score check logic is not performed.

description.zh:
类间相似度阈值。将新增人脸图片与其他所有**EntityId**内已有人脸进行相似比对，大于等于该阈值则表示其他**EntityId**内存在相似人脸，出现重复，添加失败。取值范围\[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做类间相似度判断逻辑。参考值见[人脸比对1:1](~~151891~~)接口的返回结果字段**Thresholds**。

> 类间相似度阈值检查仅适用于每个EntityId下首次上传的第一张人脸图片。
description.en:
The inter-entity similarity threshold. The new face image is compared with existing faces in all other **EntityId** values. If the similarity score is greater than or equal to this threshold, a similar face exists in another **EntityId**, indicating duplication, and the addition fails. Valid values: \[0.0,100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that the inter-entity similarity check logic is not performed. For reference values, see the **Thresholds** field in the response of the [CompareFace](~~151891~~) operation.

> The inter-entity similarity threshold check applies only to the first face image uploaded under each EntityId.

description.zh: 类内相似度阈值。将新增人脸图片与**EntityId**内已有人脸进行相似比对，小于该阈值则表示与其他人脸图片差异较大，添加失败.；若**EntityId**内没有人脸存在，则添加成功。取值范围\[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做类内相似度判断逻辑。参考值见[人脸比对1:1](~~151891~~)接口的返回结果字段**Thresholds**。
description.en: The intra-entity similarity threshold. The new face image is compared with existing faces within the **EntityId**. If the similarity score is less than this threshold, the face image is considered too different from the other face images and the addition fails. If no faces exist within the **EntityId**, the addition succeeds. Valid values: \[0.0,100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that the intra-entity similarity check logic is not performed. For reference values, see the **Thresholds** field in the response of the [CompareFace](~~151891~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
批量添加人脸数据能力可以为已创建好的人脸样本中批量添加人脸数据，每个人脸样本最多可以添加5张人脸照片，所以批量添加最多一次添加5张人脸照片。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。

><notice>
本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
></notice>

3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/BatchAddFaces?lang=JAVA)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 输入限制
- 图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP。
- 图像大小：不超过5 MB。
- 图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于4096×4096像素。人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。

>当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见[图片缩放](~~44688~~)。 

## 限制说明
批量添加人脸数据接口提交任务并发默认为2QPS。

## 计费说明
批量添加人脸数据能力可免费调用。
descriptions.en:
## Feature Description
The Batch Add Face Data feature allows you to batch add face data to existing face samples. Each face sample can contain up to 5 face photos, so a maximum of 5 face photos can be added in a single batch operation.

> - You can visit [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to get online assistance.
- For API integration, usage, or inquiries about Visual AI capabilities on the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Integration Guide
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Register Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to complete the registration.
2. Activate the service: Make sure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).

><notice>
This feature is available to enterprise or individual verified users. For more information about identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
></notice>

3. Create an AccessKey: Make sure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, you need to grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/BatchAddFaces?lang=JAVA) to debug the feature online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
- Find and install the SDK package with the AI category of Face and Body (facebody) in the corresponding language SDK documentation.
- Modify and call the sample code provided in the documentation.

6. Client-side direct calls: The following are common client-side call methods for this feature.
- [Direct call from Web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct call in mini program scenarios](~~467780~~)
- [Direct call from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct call from iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Limits
- Image format: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP.
- Image size: No larger than 5 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 32×32 pixels and less than 4096×4096 pixels. The face area must be no less than 64×64 pixels.
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see [Image Resizing](~~44688~~).

## Throttling
The default concurrency limit for the Batch Add Face Data operation is 2 QPS.

## Billing
The Batch Add Face Data feature is free of charge.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun facebody batch-add-faces --db-name default --entity-id U1 --similarity-score-threshold-in-entity 50.0 --similarity-score-threshold-between-entity 50.0 --faces ImageURL=https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/imgsearch/demo/1.png ExtraData=王小二 --quality-score-threshold 50.0 --api-version 2019-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun facebody BatchAddFaces --region cn-hangzhou --EntityId U1 --SimilarityScoreThresholdBetweenEntity '50.0' --QualityScoreThreshold '50.0' --DbName default --SimilarityScoreThresholdInEntity '50.0' --Faces '[{"ImageURL":"https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/imgsearch/demo/1.png","ExtraData":"王小二"}]'
